objective: R2D-02 quirurgico: obtener columnas reales de Compras_Inventarios_Fisicos_Sync. Solo lectura; una consulta; sin POS LIVE, Mongo, DDL ni DML.

queries.name: inventory_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id, c.name AS column_name, TYPE_NAME(c.user_type_id) AS data_type, c.max_length, c.precision, c.scale, c.is_nullable, c.is_identity FROM sys.columns c WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Compras_Inventarios_Fisicos_Sync') ORDER BY c.column_id;
